def tips(fr):

            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))

def whites(fr):
    d=[]

        if n['color']=='W':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.append((min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows)))
    return sorted(d)

def tips(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'NpY':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return d
def whites(fr):
    d=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.append((min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows)))
    return sorted(d)
